title: Telco Customer Churn Prediction
summary: Predicts which telecom customers will churn so businesses can intervene before losing them. End-to-end pipeline across 7,000+ records with three models compared.

title: Sri Lanka Fuel Price Intelligence Pipeline
summary: An end-to-end AWS data pipeline ingesting global crude oil prices, USD/LKR exchange rates, and Sri Lankan retail fuel prices into a star-schema warehouse for BI dashboards.

title: MARGA Research Hub
summary: Browse, search, and filter research papers from Marga Institute and partner organizations - built entirely client-side over a structured paper archive.

title: Colombo Transport Optimization
summary: Models and optimizes real traffic flow across Colombo's road network to identify bottlenecks and suggest routing improvements using linear programming.

title: Weather Prediction Model
summary: Predicts localized weather patterns - temperature, rainfall, humidity - to support agricultural planning and crop demand forecasting.

title: Retail Price Prediction
summary: Group data science project modelling and forecasting retail pricing trends as part of the second-year Data Science Group Project.

title: Audio Trimmer
summary: A fully client-side web app for loading, previewing, trimming, and exporting audio - no upload, everything runs in the browser.

title: Lecture Notes Processor
summary: Upload a lecture PDF and get an exam-focused summary and flashcards back in seconds - extracted fully in-browser, powered by Groq's Llama 3.3 70B.

title: MealMatch
summary: A recommendation system that learns from Food.com ratings and personal likes to give tailored meal suggestions.

title: Bookify
summary: A complete online bookstore - browse, search, filter, cart, and checkout - fully client-side in React with dynamic state management.

title: Media Database Manager
summary: CLI tool to organize personal collections of movies, TV series, and anime - search, filter, and analyze your library with full CRUD and SQL joins.

title: Team Formation System
summary: Automatically forms balanced esports tournament teams by factoring in player skill levels and personality assessments - not random assignment.

title: Card Game
summary: A classic trick-taking card game that runs in the terminal - play against 3 AI opponents, choose trumps, and try to win the most tricks.

title: Sliding Puzzle
summary: A classic 8-puzzle implementation with 80+ solvable configurations, 4 difficulty levels, and multiple winning layouts - every puzzle guaranteed solvable.

title: PDF Architect
summary: Converts images to PDFs with batch mode, parallel conversion, and smart sorting - usable as a CLI tool or a Python API.

title: World Bank Data Fetcher
summary: A zero-config CLI tool that searches the World Bank Open Knowledge Repository by topic, country, and year - exports to XML, CSV, JSON, or PDF with a live progress UI.

title: Brain-to-Text BCI Research
summary: Technical proposal for a non-invasive EEG-to-text BCI, developed with faculty at University of Moratuwa and University of Kelaniya.
